title: Fix Parent Connection Section Visibility
description: Fix the parent connection section not appearing in the piece detail panel when a child piece is selected. The bidirectional connection lookup was already implemented but the React component is not rendering the parentConnection TreeItem. Debug and fix the root cause.
summary: Research complete. ConnectionScopeProvider+useConnection+connection hooks pipeline is correctly implemented for parentConnection rendering. No bugs found in store resolution, reactivity or setter wiring. All hooks work correctly for same-design parent connections.
